shortBulletSummary: Overall crypto market sentiment is "Greed" (74) and technically "Bullish" (85).
Bitcoin surged above $81,000 with $731M in ETF inflows; Ethereum holds above $2,500.
Upcoming US Nonfarm Payrolls and CPI data are crucial for Fed rate hike expectations.
SEC proposed "Regulation Crypto Assets" and allowing blockchain share registers; UK FCA opened crypto/stablecoin licensing.
Solana ETFs see continued inflows; Japan's Remixpoint shifted to a Bitcoin-only treasury, selling ETH and XRP.
